summary.text: Jill Cooper is a Republican state representative from Pennsylvania House District 55 who took office on December 1, 2022, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Her career was in sales and marketing, including as a vice president at Alcoa.

paragraphs.text: Cooper grew up in Plum Borough, Pennsylvania, lives in Murrysville, and graduated from Plum Senior High School.
She earned a B.S. in management engineering from Grove City College in 1984, and her career experience includes working as a vice president of sales and marketing for Alcoa.
Cooper succeeded Jason Silvis in District 55.
In the 2023-2024 session she was assigned to the Aging & Older Adult Services, Urban Affairs & Housing, and Labor & Industry committees.
Democrat Davon Magwood is her opponent on the November 3, 2026 ballot.
